pm_is_active.meaning: PM (HyperLiquid precompile mode) is active when executeHedge is called

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: an active BLP reserve exists for the spot asset token being hedged

accounting_reads_revert.meaning: accounting reads (surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) revert because _readL1Backing queries 0x811 for a token never supplied to BLP

assumptions: executeHedge is the entry point that buys the spot asset and registers it in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply
The spot asset token registered is the same token later queried from the 0x811 precompile by _readL1Backing
Recovery from a bad registry entry requires an operator to call removeSuppliedEntry

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether registration is permissionless; the applicability scope of the reserve check is therefore not fully determined

limitations: The reserve-existence condition is encoded as a Boolean because the report gives no numeric reserve quantity or threshold
The revert is modeled as a Boolean observable of the accounting read outcome rather than a specific revert selector, which the report does not provide
